CANDIDATE-51.description: Temporal freshness starvation during network lag (>500ms)
CANDIDATE-51.remediation: Enforced hardware PTS age ceiling in ProvenanceRecord.

CANDIDATE-55.description: Boundary chatter oscillations near threshold (+/- 3cm jitter)
CANDIDATE-55.safety_impact: Rapid alarm chatter causes operator alarm fatigue.
CANDIDATE-55.remediation: Hysteresis clearance band (0.15m) and temporal dwell dampening applied.
